Initial release of mt5-headless-automation: Run MetaTrader 5 headless with robust EA management on Linux/VPS.

- Automates MT5 install and setup (Wine, Xvfb, xdotool, OCR) for headless operation.
- Enables login, EA attachment, deployment, and verification without display.
- Includes watchdog for automatic EA restart based on heartbeat.
- Documents and provides fixes for common MT5 automation pitfalls.
- Supplies ready-to-use scripts for deployment and monitoring.
